$comment: Canary routing queries. Each entry pairs a colloquial user request with the fixture skill a well-routed agent should read first. 3 per skill (16 skills, 8 near-neighbor pairs), zh/en mixed. Per skill: one colloquial direct ask, one boundary-adjacent phrasing that flirts with the near neighbor, and one cross-cutting/exclusion-bait query that names the neighbor's domain while this skill stays primary. Difficulty is calibrated so the weak router lands off-ceiling (~85-95%) — do not copy wording from skill descriptions.
